observations.period: 2026 report; scam channels, worry, and consumer switching

observations.period: November 6-12, 2025; awareness and perceived legitimacy of cultural policy

observations.geography: Canada; national online survey of people aged 16 and older
observations.period: July 27-August 10, 2026; mental-health and substance-use support experience

observations.title: Chile’s cultural participation is high in aggregate but sharply constrained by age, socioeconomic status, disability, and time

observations.value: Cultural, leisure, media, and sports time is nearly universal as a daily category, but the available duration still competes with work, care, learning, and self-maintenance

observations.title: India's cultural and leisure time is widespread, but gendered unpaid work changes who can actually use it

observations.period: January-December 2024; gendered time allocation
observations.value: The same survey category shows near-universal leisure participation while unpaid domestic and care work is strongly gendered, making cultural time an unequal conversion resource rather than a neutral preference

observations.title: India's cultural and leisure time is widespread, but gendered unpaid work changes who can actually use it

observations.period: January-December 2024; rural-urban and age differences
observations.value: Urban residence is associated with slightly broader and longer culture/leisure/media/sports time, while children have substantially more daily time in the broad category than working-age adults

observations.title: Indonesia shows broad neighborhood social participation but thin formal organizational reach

observations.value: Local sociality remains a high-reach layer even when formal organizational membership is much thinner; community participation may be carried by recurring, place-based, religious, and life-event institutions rather than standing organizations

observations.title: Indonesia shows broad neighborhood social participation but thin formal organizational reach

observations.period: 2025; formal meeting participation during the previous year
observations.value: Formal voice is a narrower conversion stage than general local social participation, and access to the meeting channel is sharply gendered before the separate question of speaking within the meeting

observations.title: Indonesia shows broad neighborhood social participation but thin formal organizational reach

observations.period: 2025; organization membership outside work or school
observations.value: Standing organizational membership is a low-reach layer relative to episodic or recurring community activity, suggesting that social connection does not automatically convert into durable institutional affiliation

observations.title: Indonesia's internet use is widespread, but the device ecology remains mobile-first with low computer and fixed-line ownership
observations.geography: Indonesia; national population, households, and internet users represented by Susenas 2024
observations.period: 2023-2024; national internet use and mobile-phone ownership
observations.value: Internet use is expanding alongside mobile ownership, making mobile devices the primary gateway to digital culture, sociality, and commerce for a large population; the aggregate does not reveal quality, affordability, or depth of use

observations.title: Indonesia's internet use is widespread, but the device ecology remains mobile-first with low computer and fixed-line ownership

observations.period: 2024; household technology ownership and internet-user device access
observations.value: The Indonesian digital-consumer stack is overwhelmingly handset-based: almost all internet users use mobile cellular devices, while computer ownership and fixed-line telephony are minority conditions

observations.title: Indonesia's internet use is widespread, but the device ecology remains mobile-first with low computer and fixed-line ownership
observations.geography: Indonesia; national population, households, and internet users represented by Susenas 2024
observations.period: 2024; location ecology of internet access
observations.value: Home remains the dominant access location, but public and mobile-mobility access are material secondary layers, suggesting that digital cultural and consumer participation can move across household, public, and transit spaces

observations.title: Japan’s modeled household consumption falls in real terms while category and household-type exposure diverge
observations.geography: Japan; all households, single-person households, two-or-more-person households, and ten major expenditure categories
observations.period: July 2026 compared with July 2025; household consumption trend index
observations.value: Near-flat nominal consumption can conceal a real contraction when prices absorb household spending; the signal is about purchasing-power-adjusted consumption movement, not only cash outlays

observations.title: Kenya’s mobile-finance adoption is deepening while exclusion, debt distress, and consumer-protection risks remain

observations.period: 2024; financial access and exclusion
observations.value: Formal access can rise while exclusion remains concentrated among young and rural adults, so aggregate inclusion does not guarantee equal ability to transact, save, borrow, or recover from shocks

observations.title: Kenya’s mobile-finance adoption is deepening while exclusion, debt distress, and consumer-protection risks remain

observations.period: 2024; digital-finance usage and credit/savings behavior
observations.value: Mobile money is not merely an access bridge: it is a high-frequency transaction layer increasingly connected to credit, government funds, e-commerce, and short-term liquidity, while savings participation falls and product categories overlap

observations.title: Kenya’s mobile-finance adoption is deepening while exclusion, debt distress, and consumer-protection risks remain
observations.geography: Kenya; adults aged 18 years and older in conventional households, nationally and across rural/urban areas and all 47 counties, with sex, age, education, wealth, disability, and provider dimensions
observations.period: 2024; debt distress, loss, and financial health
observations.value: Digital financial scale can widen transaction capability while exposing users to downtime, hidden charges, loss, default, and uneven financial health; consumer power requires remedy and product suitability, not only access

observations.title: Kenya’s mobile reach exceeds internet and household connectivity, with sharp rural and county gaps
observations.geography: Kenya; individuals and households across all 47 counties, with rural/urban, sex, age, education, income, employment, disability, and county dimensions
observations.period: March–May 2024; individual ICT ownership and use
observations.value: Mobile use is a wider reach layer than internet or computer use, and shared-device use means access may be mediated by ownership, household control, data affordability, and privacy rather than simple connectivity

observations.title: Kenya’s mobile reach exceeds internet and household connectivity, with sharp rural and county gaps
observations.geography: Kenya; individuals and households across all 47 counties, with rural/urban, sex, age, education, income, employment, disability, and county dimensions
observations.period: March–May 2024; county-level internet usage
observations.value: A national digital-consumer headline conceals county-level opportunity structures: platform access, online commerce, media discovery, and digital public services are likely to be encountered under very different local connectivity conditions

observations.title: Kenya’s mobile reach exceeds internet and household connectivity, with sharp rural and county gaps
observations.geography: Kenya; individuals and households across all 47 counties, with rural/urban, sex, age, education, income, employment, disability, and county dimensions
observations.period: March–May 2024; household connectivity and fixed/mobile ecology
observations.value: Kenya’s household digital ecology is mobile-led but not equivalent to stable household connectivity: fixed access, computer ownership, privacy, and reliability may be missing even when a household has some mobile internet route

observations.title: Post-crisis adaptation is reorganizing AI expectations, practical consumption, identity, wellness, and cultural belonging

observations.period: January-November 2025; online discourse analyzed for 2026 trend forecast

observations.value: AI adoption is accompanied by a governance conversation about employment, safety, fairness, security, and institutional responsibility

observations.title: Post-crisis adaptation is reorganizing AI expectations, practical consumption, identity, wellness, and cultural belonging

observations.period: 2025 year-on-year online discourse; identity and practical consumption
observations.value: Household constraint can be culturally reframed as agency, efficiency, and individualized life design

observations.title: Post-crisis adaptation is reorganizing AI expectations, practical consumption, identity, wellness, and cultural belonging
observations.geography: South Korea; online discourse from Korean news, social media, online communities, and video platforms
observations.period: 2025 year-on-year online discourse; K-culture and emotional economy
observations.value: Cultural participation can operate simultaneously as consumption, identity, national image, emotional affiliation, and economic activity

observations.title: South Korean leisure and group participation rebound while generalized social trust declines
observations.geography: South Korea; residents aged 13 or 19 and over depending on the module, with two-year comparisons to 2023
observations.period: 2025; leisure and cultural participation in the previous 12 months, compared with 2023
observations.value: Post-pandemic leisure recovery is broad but uneven: travel and facility use rose more sharply than cultural venue attendance, while the share reading remained nearly flat and reading intensity declined

observations.title: South Korean leisure and group participation rebound while generalized social trust declines
observations.geography: South Korea; residents aged 13 or 19 and over depending on the module, with two-year comparisons to 2023
observations.period: 2025; social participation, volunteering, trust, and loneliness, compared with 2023 where available
observations.value: More organized activity does not automatically translate into generalized trust: people may participate through specific, instrumental, or identity-based groups while broader social confidence declines

observations.title: Delivered mobile radars turn allied air-surveillance procurement into an integrated capability stage
observations.geography: Lithuania and NATO integrated air and missile defence system
observations.period: October 20, 2026 delivery and integration announcement
observations.value: A delivered sensor becomes strategically consequential only through integration, staffing, availability, data-sharing, and response; delivery and declared interoperability establish a stronger capability stage without proving operational effect.

observations.title: Lithuania converts a Bolide/RBS-70 contract into reported air-defence delivery before firing readiness or protection is visible
observations.geography: Lithuania; Lithuanian Air Defence Battalion and RBS-70 short-range air-defence system
observations.period: June 12, 2026; early-June delivery announcement
observations.value: A delivered missile replenishes a named short-range air-defence system and creates a supply-continuity pathway, but delivery and technical specifications are not firing readiness or demonstrated protection.

observations.title: A Lithuania–Ukraine ammunition-factory investment creates an industrial option before construction, output, or jobs are visible
observations.geography: Alytus and Prienai district, Lithuania; Lithuania–Ukraine defence-industrial partnership
observations.period: August 14, 2026; investment-contract announcement
observations.value: A named cross-border investment contract creates a possible domestic ammunition-production option, but a commitment is not a built facility, output, realized jobs, or reduced external dependence.

observations.title: Lithuania turns Leopard 2A8 industrial strategy into named facility construction before output or readiness is visible
observations.geography: Kaunas Free Economic Zone, Lithuania; Lithuanian and German defense-industrial relationship
observations.period: October 1, 2026; construction-start announcement
observations.value: A named construction start creates a domestic industrial-capacity pathway for assembly and maintenance, but planned investment and jobs are not realized output, readiness, or reduced dependence.

observations.title: Lithuania joins a multilateral surveillance procurement before national delivery and contribution are visible
observations.geography: Lithuania and participating NATO Allies; Alliance surveillance and early-warning architecture
observations.period: July 9, 2026; collective procurement announcement
observations.value: Collective procurement can pool demand and create an Alliance surveillance architecture while leaving national delivery and realized effects unresolved.

observations.title: Lithuania and Norway turn a naval capability need into non-binding industrial cooperation before procurement is visible
observations.geography: Lithuania and Norway; Lithuanian Navy, Norwegian standardized vessel programme, and Lithuanian maritime/defence industry
observations.period: July 8–9, 2026; memorandum and maritime-capability planning announcement
observations.value: A bilateral MOU can open a domestic industrial and capability pathway while leaving procurement, execution, and operational effect unresolved.

observations.title: Defense-industrial funding creates a regional production option before output or readiness is visible
observations.geography: Panevėžys district, Lithuania; Estonia and European defense-industrial supply chains
observations.period: October 20, 2026 EU funding-selection announcement
observations.value: Competitive supranational funding can convert strategic defense demand into a named firm-and-region production option, but funding selection is an institutional input rather than realized industrial capacity or operational capability.

observations.title: Lithuania moves SkyFortress from Ukrainian test-system adoption into planned deployment before detection performance is known
observations.geography: Lithuania; national airspace-surveillance and counter-drone system
observations.period: October 2, 2026; test-system deployment announcement
observations.value: A named test deployment creates a possible surveillance input into the air-defence chain, but planned installation and testing are not validated detection or demonstrated protection.

observations.title: Lithuania converts a Spike LR2 contract into reported warehouse receipt before stockpile readiness or deterrence is visible
observations.geography: Lithuania; Lithuanian Armed Forces warehouses and Vilkas Infantry Fighting Vehicle force
observations.period: July 7, 2026; warehouse-receipt announcement
observations.value: A warehouse receipt converts an implemented ammunition contract into reported possession linked to an existing vehicle platform, but possession is not trained, sustained, or demonstrated operational capability.

observations.title: Lithuania moves Switchblade 600 capability from procurement into reported warehouse receipt before use or deterrence is visible
observations.geography: Lithuania; Lithuanian Armed Forces warehouses; United States–Lithuania defense-supply relationship
observations.period: October 7, 2026; first-shipment receipt report
observations.value: A warehouse receipt converts a procurement commitment into reported possession and a possible capability pathway, but possession is not fielded readiness or demonstrated deterrence.

observations.title: Lithuania and Ukraine turn drone and electronic-warfare cooperation into a planned joint venture before production is visible
observations.geography: Lithuania and Ukraine; Pekkla UAB and December One RND Ltd; planned Lithuanian joint venture
observations.period: October 15, 2026; Letter of Intent and planned-production announcement
observations.value: A named Letter of Intent can create a cross-border pathway for technology and production localization, but planned joint-venture formation and a 2027 target are not realized production or capability.

observations.title: Malaysia approaches universal mobile and internet access while device and place gaps remain

observations.period: 2025; household ICT access
observations.value: Basic connectivity is close to universal at the national level, but place still marks a meaningful access boundary and the device bundle is changing unevenly

observations.title: Malaysia approaches universal mobile and internet access while device and place gaps remain
observations.geography: Malaysia; household ICT access and individual ICT use, including urban-rural and sex comparisons
observations.period: 2025; individual ICT use
observations.value: The dominant consumer interface may be mobile-first: Internet and phone use are nearly universal while computer use remains materially lower

observations.value: Measuring non-visitors alongside visitors makes the conversion problem visible: public proximity is not equivalent to cultural access or participation

observations.title: AI-informed audience development converted surrounding footfall into modestly higher cultural visitation at a Maltese arts centre
observations.geography: Valletta, Malta; Spazju Kreattiv and surrounding public spaces
observations.period: 2025 study; AI-informed outreach intervention
observations.value: AI operated as an allocation tool for human cultural mediation: it located likely non-visitors, while staff supplied context and a social invitation that the sensor could not provide

observations.title: AI-informed audience development converted surrounding footfall into modestly higher cultural visitation at a Maltese arts centre
observations.geography: Valletta, Malta; Spazju Kreattiv and surrounding public spaces
observations.period: 2025 study; reported visitation outcome
observations.value: The case supplies a measurable bridge from data-informed discoverability to physical entry, while leaving the deeper audience relationship open

observations.title: Mexico’s internet access is expanding and rural gaps are narrowing, but device, age, and territorial inequalities remain

observations.title: Mexico’s internet access is expanding and rural gaps are narrowing, but device, age, and territorial inequalities remain

observations.period: 2025 MODECULT; national cultural-event attendance in the preceding 12 months

observations.period: 2025 MODECULT; event mix and active artistic practice

observations.value: Trust is more likely to improve when migration governance makes capacity, trade-offs, rights, obligations, and resource allocation visible and contestable

observations.title: New Zealand cultural participation rises while active creation falls and digital tools reshape production

observations.period: 2022, 2023, and 2025; arts, culture, and heritage participation and active creation
observations.value: Cultural life has separate audience and creator conversion stages: broad attendance recovery can coexist with less active production and persistent access friction

observations.geography: New Zealand; adults aged 18 years and over, with selected age, ethnicity, creator, and volunteer comparisons
observations.period: 2025; digital creation, generative AI, and cultural volunteering
observations.value: Cultural production is being reorganized through selective digital and generative-AI use while volunteer labor remains a social-infrastructure input; skill gaps may shape who can convert tools into cultural output

observations.period: April-October 2025; past domestic travel
observations.value: Domestic travel is partly a social-reproduction activity—family, friends, relaxation, and companion bonding—not only a leisure purchase; trip frequency and duration remain modest

observations.period: October 2025-April 2026; planned domestic travel and barriers

observations.period: June 2026 quarter and year ending June 2026; survey quality and cultural/visitor-experience scope

observations.title: Safer platform defaults can hold user choices, shifting online safety from individual vigilance toward interface design

observations.period: 2026; safety-by-design support and governance implication

observations.title: UK telecom switching is becoming an affordability response, but exit friction can convert competition into a consumer-retention problem

observations.title: UK telecom switching is becoming an affordability response, but exit friction can convert competition into a consumer-retention problem
observations.geography: United Kingdom; residential telecoms customers using broadband, landline, pay-TV, and related services

observations.value: Firm retention incentives can turn nominal consumer choice into costly time, hassle, repeated contact, missed payments, and delayed exit, weakening competition even when alternative providers exist

observations.title: UK telecom switching is becoming an affordability response, but exit friction can convert competition into a consumer-retention problem
observations.geography: United Kingdom; residential telecoms customers using broadband, landline, pay-TV, and related services

observations.title: Creative employment is geographically concentrated and structurally distinctive in London

observations.period: 2025; estimated jobs by region; creative industries under the DCMS SIC-based definition
observations.value: Creative employment is not evenly distributed across place: London has a much larger creative-job share, making cultural production, career entry, housing pressure, local identity, and regional policy capacity jointly connected rather than separate market questions

observations.title: Creative employment is geographically concentrated and structurally distinctive in London
observations.geography: London versus all other regions of the United Kingdom; Annual Population Survey estimates
observations.period: 2025; creative jobs by sex and employment type
observations.value: Creative-sector place concentration coexists with a substantial self-employed workforce and a London sex composition of roughly 40% women and 60% men, making bargaining, income volatility, care, and local opportunity part of cultural-production capacity

observations.title: Creative employment is geographically concentrated and structurally distinctive in London
observations.geography: London versus all other regions of the United Kingdom; Annual Population Survey estimates
observations.period: 2025; creative jobs by disability and qualification
observations.value: Creative opportunity is highly credentialed in London while disability representation is lower there than outside London in this estimate; the open question is whether this reflects access, occupational sorting, age and health composition, workplace accommodation, or classification

observations.title: UK household spending recovered in real terms while the income spending gap widened and recreation recovered selectively
observations.geography: United Kingdom; private households, with expenditure by income quintile, category, household type, age, economic status, and region

observations.title: UK household spending recovered in real terms while the income spending gap widened and recreation recovered selectively
observations.geography: United Kingdom; private households, with expenditure by income quintile, category, household type, age, economic status, and region
observations.period: Financial year ending 2025; income quintile distribution and discretionary categories
observations.value: Selective discretionary recovery is distributionally asymmetric: higher-income households added much more total spending while transport, holidays, sports, subscriptions, and classes recovered as optional categories

observations.title: Household cost pressure turns geopolitical risk into substitution, reduced mobility, and unequal financial room
observations.geography: Great Britain; adults ages 16 and over, 6-31 May 2026 OPN collection period
observations.period: 6-31 May 2026; international conflict translated into household exposure
observations.value: Geopolitical conflict is perceived through energy, fuel, mobility, and moral safety channels rather than only through foreign-policy opinion

observations.geography: Great Britain; adults ages 16 and over, 6-31 May 2026 OPN collection period

observations.geography: Great Britain; adults aged 16 years and over, with cost-of-living actions, water-use adaptation, age, sex, and local-restriction dimensions

observations.value: Household price pressure converts into a portfolio of defensive consumer actions: discretionary compression, search for cheaper options, and in some households reductions in essentials

observations.title: Cost pressure and drought are converting household concern into selective cutbacks and shopping adaptation in Great Britain
observations.geography: Great Britain; adults aged 16 years and over, with cost-of-living actions, water-use adaptation, age, sex, and local-restriction dimensions

observations.value: Environmental infrastructure pressure can move from public restriction and local visibility into ordinary household routines, but the response is shaped by gendered responsibility and whether households perceive a local constraint

observations.title: Festival-season cultural production leaves a payment-network signal distinct from attendance

observations.period: August 2026 compared with July 2026; inter-organisation payments involving Scottish arts organisations
observations.value: Festival-season cultural production can be observed as inter-organisation payment activity and geographic network concentration before it is interpreted as audience attendance or consumer spending

observations.value: Place-based consumer presence can recover year-on-year while weakening month-on-month, creating a timing and geography layer for cultural venues, high streets, and festival-linked spending without identifying cultural attendance

observations.title: Near-real-time consumer activity weakens while entertainment spending and payment failures diverge
observations.geography: United Kingdom, with regional retail-footfall comparisons and UK-wide aggregated payment indicators
observations.period: August 2026 compared with August 2025; direct-debit payment reliability
observations.value: Payment failure can reveal household budget friction at recurring commitments, with discretionary fitness and loan categories showing higher failure rates than the aggregate series

observations.title: Near-real-time consumer activity weakens while entertainment spending and payment failures diverge
observations.geography: United Kingdom, with regional retail-footfall comparisons and UK-wide aggregated payment indicators
observations.period: August 2026 compared with July 2026 and August 2025; automotive fuel demand
observations.value: Price pressure can appear as lower quantity demanded per fuel transaction, adding a mobility-cost channel to consumer and cultural optionality without observing individual travel decisions

observations.title: Philippine digital participation is exposed to widespread cyber incidents while awareness and reporting remain low

observations.title: Philippine digital participation is exposed to widespread cyber incidents while awareness and reporting remain low

observations.period: 2024; incident exposure and official reporting

observations.title: Philippine digital participation is exposed to widespread cyber incidents while awareness and reporting remain low
observations.geography: Philippines; individuals aged 10 years and over and ICT-device users across regions
observations.period: 2024; incident modality and regional risk
observations.value: SMS fraud dominates the mobile-first risk surface, while regional patterns differ enough that a single national digital-risk profile obscures localized exposure

observations.title: The Philippines' mobile internet expansion is becoming a social-commerce economy, but cash and trust still structure the transaction
observations.geography: Philippines; individuals aged 10 years and over and internet users across regions
observations.period: 2019-2024; online purchasing and buyer transaction ecology
observations.value: Digital access is converting into routine online purchasing, but the transaction remains handset-led, delivery-dependent, and cash-mediated rather than fully digitized end to end

observations.title: The Philippines' mobile internet expansion is becoming a social-commerce economy, but cash and trust still structure the transaction
observations.geography: Philippines; individuals aged 10 years and over and internet users across regions
observations.period: 2024; social selling and digital livelihood activity
observations.value: Social platforms are not only attention channels but low-barrier storefronts and livelihood infrastructure, with commerce embedded in existing networks and cash logistics rather than separated into formal e-commerce firms

observations.title: The Philippines' mobile internet expansion is becoming a social-commerce economy, but cash and trust still structure the transaction
observations.geography: Philippines; individuals aged 10 years and over and internet users across regions
observations.period: 2024; non-use and payment trust barriers
observations.value: Digital commerce growth coexists with a strong in-person preference and security-based payment hesitation, so platform adoption is bounded by trust, habit, and transaction assurance rather than connectivity alone

observations.title: The Philippines' home internet access expanded sharply, but use remains cellphone-led and regionally uneven
observations.geography: Philippines; households and individuals aged 10 years and over across regions
observations.period: 2019-2024; household internet access at home
observations.value: Home internet access is expanding rapidly, but connection types remain mixed and mobile broadband is a major access layer; a rising access rate does not by itself establish reliable or equal digital cultural and consumer capacity

observations.title: The Philippines' home internet access expanded sharply, but use remains cellphone-led and regionally uneven
observations.geography: Philippines; households and individuals aged 10 years and over across regions
observations.period: 2024; individual internet use, device, frequency, and time
observations.value: Once connected, use is high-frequency and overwhelmingly cellphone-mediated, making the Philippines a strong mobile attention environment even though household access remains incomplete

observations.title: The Philippines' home internet access expanded sharply, but use remains cellphone-led and regionally uneven
observations.geography: Philippines; households and individuals aged 10 years and over across regions
observations.period: 2024; regional and household cost gradients
observations.value: Digital inclusion is highly regional: capital-region households have much greater home access and individual use than BARMM, while average reported internet spending fell as access expanded; affordability and access can improve together without equalizing reach

observations.title: East Shield turns border-defense strategy into measured physical implementation before civilian effects are visible

observations.period: By June 30, 2026 implementation report
observations.value: Physical implementation turns a strategic border-defense plan into material capacity, but implementation is not evidence that the works prevented an incident or improved civilian outcomes.

observations.title: Strategic energy firms plan shared threat intelligence before the resilience mechanism is operational
observations.geography: Poland; national energy and extractive strategic companies
observations.period: October 7, 2026 intent agreement and planned CyberEnergyInfo24 mechanism
observations.value: Sectoral information sharing can turn concentrated firm ownership of critical infrastructure into shared situational awareness and coordinated response, but an intent agreement does not prove usable data exchange or resilience.

observations.title: A cross-border energy link becomes a shared-responsibility and crisis-response project before operation is visible
observations.geography: Poland, Lithuania, Baltic electricity systems, and Continental Europe
observations.period: October 8–9, 2026 technical agreement and energy-security cooperation announcement
observations.value: A cross-border interconnector converts geopolitical and infrastructure dependence into shared technical responsibility and emergency-response capacity, but only commissioning and observed system performance can establish usable resilience or household benefit.

observations.title: A named satellite-infrastructure sabotage incident reaches multinational arrest without a completed security outcome

observations.period: September 23–October 12, 2026 suspected sabotage and multinational arrest response
observations.value: A critical-infrastructure incident can move from physical harm through evidence preparation and cross-border enforcement, but arrest is an institutional response stage rather than proof of restored service, final culpability, or deterrence.

observations.title: Poland’s cultural spending rose while physical and paid-digital access remained sharply stratified

observations.value: Paid digital film access expands cultural consumption alongside cinema, but both channels retain strong urban-rural gradients and streaming has an extreme age gradient; digitization changes the channel without equalizing access

observations.title: Saudi cultural participation is broad at the event level but concentrated in everyday public and commercial spaces

observations.period: 2024 survey reference year; reading and everyday leisure routes
observations.value: Everyday cultural and leisure life mixes reading with commercial and outdoor social spaces, so consumer culture is not reducible to formal arts venues

observations.title: South Africa’s payments remain cash-heavy for volume while cards carry higher-value transactions across income groups

observations.value: Cash and cards are not simple substitutes: cash dominates transaction count while debit cards carry much more transaction value, so payment modernization changes the value and visibility of consumption unevenly

observations.title: South Africa’s payments remain cash-heavy for volume while cards carry higher-value transactions across income groups

observations.title: South Africa’s payments remain cash-heavy for volume while cards carry higher-value transactions across income groups
observations.geography: South Africa; adults aged 18 years and older, with nationwide payment diaries, income-group, province, demographic, and payment-method dimensions
observations.period: 2023; stated payment use versus diary-recorded digital methods
observations.value: Reported annual adoption and observed near-term transactions are different stages: intermittent, niche, or context-specific digital methods can appear widespread in recall but rarely in a short transaction diary

observations.title: South Africa's digital access is widespread but mobile-first and sharply uneven across provinces

observations.period: 2010-2025; household internet access by location and device

observations.title: South Africa's digital access is widespread but mobile-first and sharply uneven across provinces

observations.period: 2025; provincial digital-access gradients

observations.title: South Africa's digital access is widespread but mobile-first and sharply uneven across provinces
observations.geography: South Africa; private households across all nine provinces and residents in workers' hostels
observations.period: 2025; household structure and material room
observations.value: Digital access sits inside highly differentiated household structures and material constraints; connectivity can expand while food insecurity, grant dependence, and household isolation continue to shape what digital or cultural consumption is affordable and meaningful

observations.period: August 2024-July 2025 reference period; survey fielded August-November 2025

observations.title: South Korea's direct cultural attendance fell in 2025 while active participation and cultural education rose

observations.period: August 2024-July 2025 reference period; active culture and arts engagement

observations.title: South Korea's direct cultural attendance fell in 2025 while active participation and cultural education rose
observations.geography: South Korea; residents aged 15 and above across 17 metropolitan and provincial areas
observations.period: August 2024-July 2025 reference period; leisure satisfaction and continuity
observations.value: Leisure satisfaction and continuity can rise even while a major cultural-attendance measure falls, indicating that household leisure adaptation may preserve wellbeing through other activities, settings, or routines

observations.title: Spanish household budgets gave recreation, sport, and culture more nominal room in 2025 while essential spending remained sharply unequal by spending quintile

observations.period: 2025; household-type and regional spending divergence
observations.value: Household structure and place alter the room available for discretionary cultural and consumer choices before preferences or attendance are observed

observations.period: 2024 provisional advance; annual place-based and live participation
observations.value: Place-based cultural participation remains broad alongside digital reach; heritage, museums, live events, and cinema form a dense but nonuniversal cultural gateway

observations.title: Spain's cultural life combines high digital reach, substantial place-based participation, and gendered active practice

observations.period: 2024 provisional advance; active practice and sex differences
observations.value: Cultural participation includes active creation, and gender differences vary by practice: women report more reading while men report more monthly videogame use

observations.period: 2024-2025 survey; annual and monthly cultural participation
observations.value: Cultural participation is broad across reading, institutional visits, live events, and cinema rather than concentrated in one channel

observations.title: Spain's cultural participation has recovered broadly, but access is now a hybrid physical-platform system

observations.value: Digital access is layered onto, rather than replacing, physical cultural infrastructure; the measures are not mutually exclusive

observations.title: Spain's cultural participation has recovered broadly, but access is now a hybrid physical-platform system
observations.geography: Spain; population aged 15 years and above
observations.period: 2024-2025 survey; platform subscriptions and participation gaps by sex
observations.value: Household cultural access is increasingly platform-mediated, but platform uptake and cultural practice remain differentiated by content type and gender

observations.title: Accessibility barriers can prevent travel before a trip begins for Canadians with disabilities

observations.period: January 2022 to February 2025; intercity or out-of-town travel
observations.value: Mobility access can fail at the infrastructure and service-interface stage: people may face barriers at terminals or onboard before cultural, social, consumer, or care destinations become reachable

observations.title: Accessibility barriers can prevent travel before a trip begins for Canadians with disabilities
observations.geography: Canada; persons aged 15 years and older with disabilities or long-term conditions, with travel, daily-activity difficulty, support, and accessibility-barrier dimensions
observations.period: January 2022 to February 2025; unmet transportation need and accommodation
observations.value: The hidden price of mobility includes anticipated failure and administrative uncertainty: possible accessibility problems can stop a trip before purchase or departure, while request knowledge and service explanation affect whether support is realized

observations.title: Digital access is a practical consumer and civic bottleneck for Canadians with disabilities

observations.period: 2022; communication and Internet-use accessibility barriers
observations.value: Digital access is not only a communications issue: it is a gate into public services, appointments, banking, shopping, consumer remedy, and civic participation

observations.title: Digital access is a practical consumer and civic bottleneck for Canadians with disabilities

observations.period: 2024; technology-device and online communication barriers among persons with disabilities or long-term conditions
observations.value: The practical bottleneck can occur inside ordinary interfaces—installation, touchscreens, adjustable settings, support access, and time limits—so nominal digital availability is not equivalent to usable access

observations.title: Canadian cultural output grows while cultural jobs contract, with broadcasting up and film/video down
observations.geography: Canada; national culture and sport sectors and selected subdomains
observations.period: Fourth quarter 2025 to first quarter 2026; culture and sport production
observations.value: Cultural economic growth does not automatically convert into employment growth; production, pricing, productivity, subdomain mix, and worker bargaining can move differently

observations.title: Hybrid friendship contact is dominant in Canada, while virtual-only connection is associated with lower satisfaction and greater loneliness

observations.period: 1992-2022; reported time pressure

observations.title: Canadian time pressure and shrinking everyday friendship contact make social connection a scarce household resource

observations.period: 1986-2022; everyday friendship contact
observations.value: Everyday social connection is becoming less frequent in the time diary, suggesting that friendship and belonging compete with work, care, commuting, digital activity, and household demands for scarce time

observations.title: Canadian time pressure and shrinking everyday friendship contact make social connection a scarce household resource

observations.period: 1986-2022; duration and unmet social time
observations.value: The social-time constraint appears at both margins: fewer people encounter friends on a given day, and those who do spend less time together, while concern about insufficient family and friendship time rises

observations.title: Danish cultural participation is age- and place-shaped differently across digital games, cinema, museums, and heritage

observations.period: Q2 2026; cultural and recreational participation within the previous 12 months by age
